units.source_text: “把它卷成筒，在里面塞些东西就好了。”

en.t: Roll it into a tube and stuff something inside, and it should be fine.

units.source_text: 母亲也在一旁插了句嘴。

en.t: My mother also put in a word from the side.

units.source_text: 父亲仔细端详了一阵后，起身走到壁龛前，把这张毕业证书摆在一眼就能看见的正中央。

en.t: After studying it carefully for a while, my father got up, went to the alcove, and placed the diploma right in the center where it could be seen at a glance.

units.source_text: 要是以往，我马上就会嘟哝起来的，然而，那天的我没有表现出丝毫不乐意，默不作声地任凭父亲去放置。

en.t: Ordinarily I would have started grumbling at once, but that day I showed no displeasure at all and silently let my father arrange it as he liked.

units.source_text: 被压皱了的雁皮纸毕业证书，父亲费了半天劲也摆不好，刚摆在合适的位置，它便歪倒下来，又慢慢恢复了原状。

en.t: The creased ganpi-paper diploma would not sit properly no matter how hard my father tried; the moment he set it in the right place, it leaned over and then slowly returned to its former shape.

units.source_text: 1.雁皮纸：以雁皮的树皮为原料制成的一种非常薄的日本纸。

en.t: 1. Ganpi paper: a very thin Japanese paper made from the bark of the ganpi plant.

units.source_text: 因雁皮生长缓慢且无法大量采伐，故价格昂贵。

en.t: Because ganpi grows slowly and cannot be harvested in large quantities, it is expensive.
